sessions.feedback: No blockers this session. Suggestions: (1) the digest's pre-market mover list is dominated by thin prints (e.g. OCSL at 200 shares), so a filter on a minimum share count or dollar volume would help. (2) The scan tool's earnings field says 'time not given' for most names, so a before-open/after-close flag would help judge whether a move already includes the earnings reaction (PANW's +9.9% regular-session move looked like earnings but came before the report). (3) A ticker-level 'consensus vs actual' feed would save web searches.

The NVDA CNBC article could not be fetched with read_page. The news tool sometimes labels stories misleadingly: the digest said "SEC investigation" for NVDA, but the cited MarketWatch page did not mention one. The helper answers are useful for checking claims. Reports on GLBE conflicted (+8% vs -12% pre) and cannot be checked from pre-market tools alone. A consensus-vs-actual field in scan would save web searches.

The data was sufficient. Pre-market prints on thin volume (e.g. ESLT +8% on 605 shares, ACM, KNX) are hard to trust, so a pre-market VWAP or a bid/ask indication would help judge the likely opening price. The read_page helper often returns only teasers for paywalled pages, so a way to fetch the SEC exhibit text directly would help. Consensus estimates were not available from the tools and I had to use web search for them.
No blocking issues. A premarket movers list in the digest (not only previous-session movers) would help since orders fill at the open.
No VIX or futures data in tools; would help judge the volatility regime.

summary:
Session 2026-11-19.

Session 2026-11-19 (pre-open). Context: Anthropic IPO priced at $83 ($81B raise, about $1.5T value) with the debut today. QQQ pre +2.1% and SPY pre +1.2% after a 5-day slide (SPY -3.9%). NVDA pre +1.5% (~153) after five straight losses. AS pre +0.4%, ESLT pre -0.2% (closed -3.1%, no news).
Trade: opened long P (Everpure, ex-Pure Storage) at 4%. Q3 revenue +51% ($1.46B vs $1.33B est), op income $345M vs $265-275M guide, FY27 revenue and op-income guides raised. The stock was 36% off its high after 4 down days, pre +7%. Stop 12%, target 22%, 10 days, prob 0.54. Fade risk: it fell 9% the day after the Aug 26 beat; gross margin 68%, price cuts, FY28 guide unchanged. Barclays cut its PT to 115, Piper raised to 166.
Held: AS (7.1%), ESLT (4.8%), NVDA (5.7%). Total exposure about 22% after P.
NVDA calendar: Bessent answer ~11-26, Huang Senate Banking hearing 12-03 (earlier note said 12-01), Lutnick 12-10, 10-Q delayed, Commerce reportedly rushed H200 China approvals.
Skipped: PANW (+20% over two days, chasing), WSM (-8.5% pre, EPS in line, guide reiterated), BBWI (sales -1%, EPS down y/y), BABA (adj EPS big miss, cloud growth to slow), PDD (revenue miss), NTES (miss), WMT (narrow beat), KLIC (small cap).
Check next session: P and NVDA open vs Anthropic-debut sell-the-news risk; FOMC minutes reaction; ROST/INTU/GAP/KEYS after-close reports; ESLT vs stop 654; the three 10-day reviews (AS/ESLT 12-02, NVDA 12-03, P ~12-04).
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Stayed cash. Looked at GOOGL (-12% EPS miss/capex), NOW (-27%), FTNT (-20% despite beat/raise), ADT (take-private, pinned), CROX (+21% priced in).
Session 2 (10-30): Premarket tech selloff: INTC -25%, AMZN -6%, AMD -9%, DELL -8%. Cash.
Session 3 (11-02): SPY -1.77%, QQQ -3.47%, INTC -28.6%, RDDT -29%. Cash.
Session 4 (11-03): Falling knives kept falling: FTNT 126 (-7%), INTC 60 (-8.8%). Lesson: buying rebounds right after a crash would have lost; wait for stabilisation.
Sessions 5-6 (11-10, 11-11): Cash. Hot CPI, 10y near 5%, Fed hike bets. CRWV +24.7% on beat.
Session 7 (11-12): Cash. WSJ: Nvidia board weighed removing Huang. NVDA -8% pre.
Session 8 (11-13): Cash. NVDA closed 166, Huang exit headlines, House subpoena threat.
Session 9 (11-16): Cash. Huang resigned; Bessent demands external CEO, answers ~11-26. TU, CGON, SMMT, PERI priced/pinned.
Session 10 (11-17): First trades: long AS (Q3 beat/raise/$1B buyback, 5 down days into print) 7% and long ESLT (Elbit Q3 beat, record backlog, 4-day slide) 5%. 10-day drift trades, stops 8%/10%, targets 15%.
Session 11 (11-18): NVDA blowout (rev 115.8B vs 109B, guide 130B vs 125B, +$150B buyback). Opened long NVDA 6% (stop 9%, target 16%, 10 days) after 2 days of stabilisation at 149-150. Skipped TJX, LOW, TGT, GLBE, TTWO, BRBR, ARDT.
Session 12 (11-19): Context: Anthropic IPO priced $83 ($81B raise, ~$1.5T value), debut today; QQQ pre +2.1%, SPY +1.2% after 5-day slide (SPY -3.9%, QQQ -4.5%). NVDA closed 150.96 (5th straight loss), pre +1.5%. AS +2.3%, ESLT -3.1% (-4% vs cost, no news). Opened long P (Everpure, ex-Pure Storage) 4%: rev +51% 10% above est, FY27 op-inc guide +14%, stock -36% from high, 4 down days into print; pre +7%. Held AS, ESLT, NVDA. Skipped: PANW (+9.9% day before and +10% pre after beat/raise, chasing), WSM (-8.5% pre, EPS in line, guide reiterated, fell after Aug beat too), BBWI (sales -1%, EPS down y/y, guide held), BABA (rev beat, adj EPS big miss, cloud growth to decel to 30-45%), PDD (rev miss, profit beat, +6% pre), NTES (miss, -6%), WMT (narrow beat/raise, pre -1%), KLIC (small cap).
Lessons: Catalyst moves in biotech/M&A are priced by open (TU, CGON, SMMT, SLS). Whipsaw tape: gap-ups reversed (CRWV 11-11). Earnings beats where the stock slid into the print and guidance was raised are the best pre-open candidates; fade risk remains (AS fell 10% after Aug 18 beat/raise; FTNT -20% on beat/raise 10-29; P fell 9% the day after its Aug 26 beat). Retail earnings often include IEEPA tariff-refund benefits - use adjusted numbers (LOW 34c, WSM $29M, TGT). So far (3 days in) drift trades are mixed: AS +1.4%, ESLT -4%, NVDA -5%: measure after 10 days vs SPY. Sympathy gap-ups (cyber peers after PANW) are not trades.
Open ideas / calendar: NVDA: Bessent answer ~11-26, Huang Senate Banking hearing 12-03, Lutnick 12-10, 10-Q delayed. AS/ESLT review 12-02, NVDA 12-03, P ~12-04. ROST/INTU/GAP/KEYS report 11-19 AMC. ADI 11-24, ZM 11-23. Macro: 10y ~5.1%, Dec Fed hike priced, FOMC minutes 11-19 2pm, Williams/Kashkari speak. Watch whether the Anthropic debut becomes sell-the-news for AI hardware (P, NVDA are exposed). FTNT/INTC/NOW once a base forms. Total exposure ~22% after P; remaining cash must justify itself against SPY in a rebound.

Your universe is every eligible US stock. Your style is a few high-quality trades.

- Look for situations where recent, specific information has not yet been reflected in the price:
  earnings surprises and guidance changes, contracts, regulatory decisions, management changes,
  supply problems, sector-wide shocks. Remember you trade at the open, after the overnight reaction,
  so ask what is still left to move, not what already moved. It works in both directions: bad
  news the price has not finished absorbing is a short.
- Prefer clear catalysts you can verify over vague narratives. A strong case beats a busy portfolio,
  so concentrate on your best ideas. Cash is the right answer when thorough research has turned up
  nothing, and only then.
- Size positions by conviction and by how much could go wrong. Set stops and targets you would
  actually stand behind.
- Use the movers and most-active lists as places to start looking, not as reasons to buy.
